title: AW27 Men's Pink for All
summary: Pink and mauve enter menswear for real: dusty mauve tailoring and knits, from sweatshirts to suits.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Pink and mauve are becoming gender-neutral, entering menswear and even junior sweatshirts <sup>[1]</sup>. Skirts, wide shorts and sheer fabrics are entering menswear, led by Asian brands <sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Dusty mauve, silicone pink and dusky violet with tinted black.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Mauve suit.
- Pink sweatshirt.
- Wide trousers.

design_implications: - Test pinks on wool and jersey.
commercial_implications: - Start with knits and sweatshirts, then tailoring.
